messages:
jamal: FYI planning a quick dedicated rollout for Mystic Sentry (tenant: mystic-sentry) on Thu 03:00-03:40 UTC. Pinned runtime image v2.14.1-rc3. Can we confirm go/no-go and KMS status?

deploy-bot: [deploybot] queued rollout request for mystic-sentry -> v2.14.1-rc3. Canary plan: 5% for 10m, 25% for 15m, then full roll for 15m. Commands: ```deployctl start --tenant mystic-sentry --image v2.14.1-rc3 --canary 5% --stages 10m,15m,15m```

alex: Looks fine. Who owns the canary metrics watch? I can monitor latency + 5xx.

jamal: alex you own metrics. Please watch p50/p95 and error-rate. Thresholds: p95 +200ms or 5xx > 0.5% -> abort and rollback.

sophie: KMS note: customer uses BYOK key kms://projects/kythera/keys/mystic-sentry-key. Need KMS access test from the private control plane before cut. @ops-runner can you run quick decrypt test?

ops-runner: Will run now. Patch scheduled on infra side to refresh KMS creds at 02:45 UTC. I'll post result shortly.

mike: Rollback plan? If canary fails do we pin back to v2.14.0-prod or to previous DB migrationless tag? Need clear rollback command.

jamal: Rollback command: ```deployctl rollback --tenant mystic-sentry --to v2.14.0-prod --reason "canary-failure"``` DB changes: none in this release. So quick revert is safe.

ops-runner: KMS test: decrypt OK from the private control plane (02:22 UTC). No permission errors. :white_check_mark:

alex: Started baseline capture. Will alert if p95 increases >200ms or error rate threshold crossed.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started by jamal at 03:00 UTC, stage=5% (slice a1). Monitoring hooks: metrics, traces, logs. Notify channel on gate failures.

alex: 03:08 — p95 +35ms, no 5xx. Canary healthy so far.

jamal: Proceeding to 25% stage at 03:12.

deploy-bot: Stage complete: 25% at 03:27. No gate failures. Rolling remaining slices now.

mike: Observed a small spike in error-rate on slice b3 at 03:30 — 0.6% for ~2m. I recommend pausing and checking logs.

alex: Confirmed b3 had a model-serving OOM on one replica. Auto-restart recovered, but error rate breached threshold. Pausing rollout.

jamal: Pause acknowledged. Initiating investigation and rollback plan if instability persists. Alex, can you collect stack traces and sample logs for b3?

alex: Pushed logs to the incident bucket and added markers. Will tail logs and check for repeated OOMs.

ops-runner: Spinning up an extra replica on b3 slice to reduce impact. Also checking node GPU memory pressure.

mike: Still seeing intermittent 5xxs. If this doesn't drop within 5m we should rollback.

jamal: Agreed. Rolling back mystic-sentry to v2.14.0-prod now to minimize customer impact. Executing: ```deployctl rollback --tenant mystic-sentry --to v2.14.0-prod --reason "canary instability: b3 OOM"```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by jamal at 03:36 UTC. Notifying on completion.

ops-runner: Rollback completed at 03:40 UTC. All slices restored to v2.14.0-prod. Post-rollback checks: traffic normalized, p95 back to baseline.

jamal: Filing follow-up ticket to disable the OOM-causing flag in the model runtime and re-run tests. We'll reschedule a dry-run next week after fix. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :thumbsup:

alex: Adding postmortem notes and learned items to the ticket (include reproduction steps and memory profile).

sophie: Confirming KMS remained stable throughout; no customer key exposure.

mike: Recommend increasing canary dwell time for model-heavy tenants next time.

jamal: Noted. Will update rollout playbook. Closing this thread.
